{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRCof88AAAABZdE21Q", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn7ElzhDESgE", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn7El", "number": 59, "title": "Implement V30 REPC/REPNC repetition for CMPS and SCAS", "body": "## Problem

Valid V30 compare strings using REPC or REPNC stop with an unsupported-opcode host error. At baseline `feff5d3bb884edb2787f9bd1b8205a1f272f730f`, the [prefix decoder](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/feff5d3bb884edb2787f9bd1b8205a1f272f730f/src/cpu.rs#L933) recognizes `64h`/`65h` only for Ap segment overrides. VM therefore cannot execute these documented NEC extensions.

The existing string executor already processes one element per step and supports comparison, index updates and count tracking, making this a bounded extension of existing CPU behavior.

## Expected outcome

Implement VM REPC/REPNC with CMPSB, CMPSW, SCASB and SCASW, preserving Ap decoding and existing repetition behavior.

Hardware contract:

- REPC is `65h`; REPNC is `64h`.
- Initial CX zero suppresses comparison and leaves flags and indices unchanged.
- Otherwise compare once, update indices and decrement CX. Incoming CF does not suppress the first comparison.
- Continue with nonzero CX when resulting CF is set for REPC or clear for REPNC. ZF does not control repetition.
- Preserve comparison flags; count/index maintenance adds no flag changes.
- CMPS compares source minus destination; SCAS compares accumulator minus destination. Apply byte/word width, DF and normal segment rules.
- Decode prefixes together with their instruction, without an interrupt boundary between prefix and opcode.

These semantics come from NEC’s [V-Series instruction manual, REPC/REPNC, printed pp.126–127](https://www.ardent-tool.com/CPU/docs/NEC/V20-V30/v_series.pdf#page=137), and [CMPBK/CMPM, printed pp.61–64](https://www.ardent-tool.com/CPU/docs/NEC/V20-V30/v_series.pdf#page=72), corresponding to Intel-style CMPS/SCAS mnemonics.

Retain the existing one-element-per-step scheduling model; this is not an instruction-cycle accuracy change.

Scope excludes carry-repeat combinations with non-compare instructions or conflicting repeat prefixes. Keep excluded forms explicitly diagnosed and documented as emulator limitations, without inventing hardware exception semantics. Packed-BCD strings, bit-field extensions, VM TF traps, NMI, protected execution, paging and x87 implementation are outside this Issue.

## Context and reproduction

Source-derived reproduction for the Coordinator to execute:

1. On VM, place `65 A6 90` at `0000:0100`; initialize DS=ES=0, SI=`4000h`, DI=`5000h`, CX=3 and CF=0.
2. Set source bytes to `[1,5,0]` and destination bytes to `[2,4,0]`.
3. Current source reaches the unsupported `65h` diagnostic. Expected execution performs two comparisons, stops with CX=1, SI=`4002h`, DI=`5002h`, IP=`0102h`, CF=0 and ZF=0, then executes NOP.

Relevant inspected tests are [strings_are_budgeted_and_directional](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/feff5d3bb884edb2787f9bd1b8205a1f272f730f/tests/core.rs#L81), [Ap dword repetition](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/feff5d3bb884edb2787f9bd1b8205a1f272f730f/tests/cpu386.rs#L192), and Ap FS/GS coverage. None establishes VM carry-repeat support. Supplied open Issues are empty, and the supplied improvement history contains no implementation of this behavior.

Project progress: PR #58 implements VM BOUND. The [Coordinator’s validation record](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/feff5d3bb884edb2787f9bd1b8205a1f272f730f/docs/validation.md#issue-57-v30-boundchkind-2026-10-24) reports 235 native integration and 88 production-Wasm browser passes, zero skipped. Independent review and remote CI are not established by that report. This evaluation inspected source and reports only; no builds, tests or fixture preparation were executed.

All 26 inventory categories retain their supplied scopes and statuses:

- **Partial:** cpu-v30, cpu386, protected-mode, memory, pic, pit, dma, keyboard, mouse, fdc, gdc, egc, pegc, text-cg, display-timing, opn, opna, pcm86, bios, lio, integration.
- **Implemented, unverified:** ide, grcg.
- **Unimplemented:** paging, fpu, rtc.

V30 remains partial after this Issue: packed-BCD strings, bit-field extensions, TF traps, NMI and broader instruction, prefix and fault acceptance remain outstanding. Protected execution, paging and basic x87 remain required project goals. Missing evaluator-local assets do not block planning.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add an original minimal reproduction before production changes; record its baseline failure and implementation pass. Implement the complete contract above through existing CPU/Bus paths in original Rust.
- [ ] Add focused `v30_repc_` native tests covering both prefixes and all four opcodes, both initial CF values, count zero/one/multiple/FFFFh, early termination with residual count, exhaustion and contrasting ZF outcomes. Check exact IP, registers, defined flags, unchanged operands and guards.
- [ ] Exercise both directions, unaligned words, VM offset wrapping, distinct source/destination segments and legal segment-prefix orders. Demonstrate bounded stepping and a PIC IRQ between iterations followed by guest IRET and correct completion without duplicated or skipped elements.
- [ ] Add Ap tests proving `64h` and `65h` still select FS and GS for strings, including repetition and existing operand/address-size behavior. Preserve existing F2/F3 and BOUND acceptance.
- [ ] Add original MIT `guest/v30_repc.asm`, offline preparation via `python3 tools/prepare_v30_repc_fixture.py`, and a checked provenance manifest recording assembly command, license, source/boot/image hashes, expected results/guards and a maximum 2,000,000-slot budget. Keep generated fixtures outside `web/`; use no proprietary firmware or commercial guest media.
- [ ] Boot the identical prepared image natively and in production release Wasm at `/` and `/pc98-rust/`, before and after reset. Require guest-produced explicit PASS, exact results/guards, no FAIL/core/browser errors, unchanged disk bytes and bounded completion. Hosts must not patch guest results or bypass instruction execution.
- [ ] Integrate fixture preparation with existing CI and document commands, outcomes and remaining limitations. The Coordinator runs the README fixture prerequisites, focused tests and complete native/browser regressions, including:

  ```sh
  python3 tools/prepare_v30_repc_fixture.py
  cargo test --locked --test core v30_repc_
  cargo test --locked --test cpu386
  cargo test --locked
  cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
  cargo fmt --check
  git diff --check
  npm test
  ```

- [ ] Preserve existing hardware, DOS/application, VM and six-game assertions, fixtures and execution budgets. Report failures, skips and unavailable evidence honestly. Passing these probes must not be described as full V30 accuracy or commercial compatibility.

## Optional validation

None.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
